School parties are booked in advance and arrive with their own adults, but they still need a
volunteer of their own for the length of the visit. Meet them at the door, explain the rules of the hall
once, and take them round in the order the education pack sets out: crew lists, pulling boat,
platform, inshore boat, shop. The pack is on the shelf in the office with the risk assessment tucked
inside it, and both are read before the party arrives, not after it has left and the questions have

The boat hall is the heart of the museum and the place where most of a shift is spent. Visitors are
free to walk around all three boats and to climb the viewing platform beside the motor lifeboat, and
they may touch the hull of the inshore boat, which is there for that purpose. They may not board
any boat, lean on the pulling boat's oars, or lift children onto the platforms, and the volunteer on the
hall is expected to say so kindly and early rather than firmly and late. hall is expected to say so kindly and early rather than firmly and late. The photographs along the north wall are copies and may be pointed at, photographed and, within
